user.title: Mathem account

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Mathem
reauth_confirm.description: Your Mathem session expired. Enter your password again.

error.cannot_connect: Could not log in. Check the credentials and that the login handshake still works.

abort.already_configured: This Mathem account is already configured.

init.title: Mathem options
init.description: Delivery, polling and dietary profiles. Profiles are edited as JSON; see the README for the shape.

data_description.delivery_address_id: The address deliveries go to, detected automatically from your Mathem account. If you have more than one, pick it here; with a single address it is selected for you.
data_description.unattended_delivery: When the integration books a delivery slot, this tells Mathem whether the order may be left at your door without you present. Turn it off if the delivery must be handed over in person.
data_description.poll_minutes: How often the integration refreshes the cart and orders normally.
data_description.delivery_day_poll_minutes: A faster refresh used only while an order is inside its delivery window or being live tracked, so tracking stays current.
data_description.ambiguity_behaviour: What to do when a request could match several products: ask you which one, or reject it.
data_description.default_profile: The dietary profile used when a request does not name one.
data_description.filter_tokens: Diet filters Mathem currently supports; ticking them exposes them for use in profiles.
data_description.profiles_json: Dietary profiles as JSON. Prefilled with what is currently stored; leave it unchanged or empty to keep them, or replace it with an empty JSON object to remove them.

error.invalid_profiles: The profiles JSON could not be parsed or a profile inherits from an unknown parent.
